name: hangs-up-mid-disclosure
about: They put the phone down two seconds into the disclosure. The carrier never acknowledges its last frame, so the call reports disclosure_heard=false. That is a fact about them, not a failure of ours, and the hard check must say so rather than pass by assuming the disclosure played.

audio.about: The far end hangs up 2 seconds in, part-way through the disclosure. Only `npm run call` reads this; the text harness ignores it.
